sources.title: 经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版） — Guidelines for Current Account Foreign Exchange Business (2020), Huifa [2020] No. 14
sources.scope_read: notice text and Arts. 1-120 (page chunks 1-3 of 10); annexes not read

facts.claim: A foreign passport holder is an 'overseas individual' (境外个人) for Chinese FX purposes; a 'domestic individual' is a Chinese citizen holding a PRC identity card. The classification follows the identity document, not where the person lives.
facts.quote: （一）境内个人是指持有中华人民共和国居民身份证、军人身份证件、武装警察身份证件的中国公民。（二）境外个人是指持护照、港澳居民来往内地通行证、台湾居民来往大陆通行证的外国公民（包括无国籍人）以及港澳台同胞。

facts.claim: Current-account FX for individuals is convertible in principle; capital-account FX is managed according to the stage of convertibility.
facts.quote: 经常项目项下的个人外汇业务按照可兑换原则管理，资本项目项下的个人外汇业务按照可兑换进程管理。

facts.claim: An overseas individual may buy foreign exchange with lawful current-account RMB income earned in China and remit it, on presenting ID and supporting documents.
facts.quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目项下合法人民币收入，可以凭本人有效身份证件及相关证明材料在银行办理购汇及汇出。

facts.claim: The supporting documents for that purchase must show the transaction amount and include tax documents (税务凭证). The rule states no annual cap for this documented purchase.
facts.quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。

facts.claim: The USD 50,000 annual figure is a facilitation quota for FX settlement by any individual and FX purchase by domestic individuals. It is not a general purchase quota for foreign passport holders.
facts.quote: 个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度便利化额度管理，便利化额度分别为每人每年等值5万美元。

facts.claim: An overseas individual who holds a Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card does get the annual purchase quota.
facts.quote: 持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。

facts.claim: The 2007 Implementing Rules set the same USD 50,000 annual total and the same documented-purchase rule for overseas individuals.
facts.quote: 年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。… 在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇。

facts.claim: Unused RMB that an overseas individual originally obtained by converting foreign currency can be converted back against the original exchange memo, which is valid for 24 months from the exchange date. Without a memo the limit is USD 500 per day (USD 1,000 airside before departure).
facts.quote: 境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。

facts.claim: Foreign exchange already held in an overseas individual's FX account can be remitted abroad on ID alone; the rule sets no daily amount limit for this.
facts.quote: 境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外，按下列规定在银行办理：（一）外汇账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理；

facts.claim: Unused foreign exchange that an overseas individual remitted into China can be sent back along the original route on ID alone.
facts.quote: 境外个人未使用的境外汇入外汇，可以凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理原路汇回。

facts.claim: A domestic individual may remit up to USD 50,000 a day from an FX account on ID alone; above that, documents showing the transaction amount are required.
facts.quote: 外汇账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料办理。

facts.claim: Splitting transactions to get around the quota or the authenticity review is prohibited. Lending one's quota draws a risk warning and, on repetition, the watch list; borrowing another person's quota means the watch list directly. The watch period is the year of listing plus the next two years.
facts.quote: 个人不得以分拆等方式规避便利化额度管理及真实性管理。外汇局对规避管理的个人实行“关注名单”管理。… （二）外汇局对借用他人便利化额度及其他方式规避便利化额度及真实性管理的个人，列入“关注名单”管理 … （三）“关注名单”内个人的关注期限为列入“关注名单”的当年及之后连续2年。

facts.claim: The 2006 Measures contain the same prohibition on splitting and on false documents.
facts.quote: 银行和个人在办理个人外汇业务时，应当遵守本办法的相关规定，不得以分拆等方式逃避限额监管，也不得使用虚假商业单据或者凭证逃避真实性管理。

facts.claim: A bank may refuse a transaction that breaks FX rules or whose authenticity is in doubt, and must tell the individual the reason and the complaint channel.
facts.quote: 银行有权对违反外汇管理规定、真实性存疑的交易予以拒绝。对拒绝办理的业务，银行应向个人准确说明拒绝原因及申诉渠道。

facts.claim: A single service-trade payment abroad above USD 50,000 requires the tax filing (税务备案) first; the bank checks the filing form.
facts.quote: 办理单笔等值5万美元以上的服务贸易对外支付，境内机构和个人应先按照服务贸易对外支付税务备案有关规定办理备案手续，银行应核验服务贸易等项目对外支付纸质或电子税务备案表。

facts.claim: RMB from an overseas individual's sale of a home in China may be converted and remitted, subject to approval under the property rules.
facts.quote: 境外个人出售境内商品房所得人民币，经外汇局核准可以购汇汇出。

facts.claim: Transfers abroad of an emigrant's pre-emigration property and of an estate inherited by a foreign citizen follow the separate Interim Measures on individual property transfer.
facts.quote: 移居境外的境内个人将其取得合法移民身份前境内财产对外转移以及外国公民依法继承境内遗产的对外转移，按《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》等有关规定办理。

facts.claim: Transfers between FX accounts inside China are limited to a person's own accounts and close relatives' accounts; a transfer between a domestic individual's and an overseas individual's account is treated as cross-border.
facts.quote: 个人外汇账户内资金境内划转，仅限于本人账户之间、个人与近亲属账户之间。划转账户分别属于境内个人、境外个人的，按跨境交易进行管理，且应符合经常项目外汇汇出境外的规定。

facts.claim: An individual may withdraw up to USD 10,000 in foreign cash per day on ID. More than that needs a SAFE filing, available only for travel to war-torn, strictly FX-controlled or financially unstable countries.
facts.quote: 个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；个人出境赴战乱、外汇管制严格、金融条件差或金融动乱的国家（地区），确有需要提取超过等值1万美元以上外币现钞的，凭本人有效身份证件、提钞用途等材料向银行所在地外汇局事前报备。

facts.claim: Carrying foreign cash out of China: above USD 5,000 and up to USD 10,000 requires a bank-issued Permit for Carrying Foreign Exchange Abroad, unless covered by the traveller's latest inbound declaration. Above USD 10,000 requires a SAFE-issued permit, available only for travel to war-torn, strictly FX-controlled or financially unstable countries.
facts.quote: 个人携带外币现钞出境，没有或超出最近一次入境申报外币现钞数据记录的，金额在等值5000美元以上至1万美元（含）的，应向银行申领《携带外汇出境许可证》。个人赴战乱、外汇管制严格、金融条件差或金融动乱的国家（地区），确有需要携带超过等值1万美元外币现钞出境的，需向存款或购汇银行所在地外汇局申领《携带外汇出境许可证》。

facts.claim: Article 39 of the 2007 Implementing Rules (the residual fine of up to CNY 1,000 on individuals) has been repealed by Huifa [2023] No. 8.
facts.locator: amendment note at foot of page
facts.quote: 根据《国家外汇管理局关于废止和失效15件外汇管理规范性文件及调整14件外汇管理规范性文件条款的通知》（汇发〔2023〕8号）… 以下内容已被废止：《个人外汇管理办法实施细则》（汇发〔2007〕1号印发）第三十九条。
